summary: Firebase live-data fixes VERIFIED as largely working end-to-end. Signup creates users/{uid} in Firestore (proved by Admin → Users listing 3 owner accounts including both fresh emails), Owner Admin Panel banner shows on Dashboard, Admin routes (users, vehicles, master/brands|tyreModels|tyreSizes) load with ZERO 'requires an index' / FirebaseError / 'Unexpected token' errors. Shop settings persist across reload (settings/shop doc read/write works). Sale flow saves without 'Unexpected token' even when GSTIN/address/state fields are left EMPTY — TB-0004 for QA Test Customer appears in /(tabs)/billing (₹10,620, Cash). Dashboard shows Current Inventory=8 (10 initial − 2 sold), confirming stock decrement is applied. NO FirebaseError, NO 'requires an index', NO 'Unexpected token', NO 'permission-denied', NO PageError captured in console during the full flow (0 out of ~46 console messages). Three remaining issues observed: (1) direct URL navigation to /inventory/tyre-form redirects to /(tabs)/inventory because `perms.canEditStock` (in usePermissions hook) is false during first render — race between initial render and async role hydration; test scripts using page.goto directly are blocked (real users clicking Add-Tyre from the Inventory screen are NOT blocked). (2) The 'Credit' payment-mode sale did NOT redirect to /(tabs)/billing (URL stayed on /sales/new) and no matching KhataBook entry was created; KhataBook screen shows 'No customer ledger'. (3) After the sale succeeded, /inventory/car?class=new still rendered empty in the second script run — likely because no tyre was ever created (tyre-form was blocked). Overall: iteration-14 blockers (users/uid missing, Unexpected-token on Save Sale, composite-index errors) are RESOLVED. Remaining items are the credit-sale/khata write path and the tyre-form perms race.

ui_bugs.issue: Route guard `if (!perms.canEditStock) return <Redirect href="/(tabs)/inventory" />` fires BEFORE Firestore role hydration completes when the URL is opened cold (e.g. deep-link, refresh). Should either wait for `perms.loading===false` or gate on `role===null` to avoid falsely redirecting fresh-signed-in owners. Reference: /app/frontend/app/inventory/tyre-form.tsx:92

Credit sale save keeps URL on /sales/new (no redirect) and produces NO KhataBook entry. addKhataEntry is called only AFTER createSale succeeds — investigate whether the second sale run silently throws (no error surfaced, `err`/`warn` state never set), or whether router.replace is skipped due to a downstream exception. Reference: /app/frontend/app/sales/new.tsx:156-186

integration_issues.issue: Second (Credit) sale in the same session did not appear in /(tabs)/billing (bill count stayed at 2 including one previous Arbaz row) and no ledger entry exists in /khata. Suggests either: (a) the second createSale threw silently (invoicePdf.generateAndShareInvoice may throw in headless; but that is caught with .catch(() => {}) so it should not block); (b) reserveInvoiceNumber succeeded but the sale write was rejected. No Firebase error captured in console — recommend surfacing failures via setErr in the catch block. Reference: /app/frontend/app/sales/new.tsx:187

action_items: MAIN AGENT (E1): Fix perms hydration race in /app/frontend/app/inventory/tyre-form.tsx:92. `usePermissions()` should expose a `loading` state; the redirect should only fire once loading===false AND role has been fetched from Firestore. Otherwise a fresh owner signup gets bounced out of the tyre-form on cold-load.

MAIN AGENT (E1): Debug the Credit-sale save path in /app/frontend/app/sales/new.tsx. The Credit save silently fails — URL stays on /sales/new, no billing row created, no khata entry. Add console.error inside the catch and confirm which of createSale / addKhataEntry / generateAndShareInvoice is throwing. Cash-payment sale on the same page works, so likely the divergence is in the addKhataEntry branch (line 161-171) or a downstream PDF share crash on web.

MAIN AGENT (E1) — LOW: bubble up errors from createSale/addKhataEntry to the UI. Current catch sets err via e?.message but the second Credit-sale attempt shows no error text — silent failure. Consider logging + a persistent toast.

OPTIONAL (regression): No composite/single-field index errors observed anywhere in this run — the `.where().orderBy()` removals in inventory.ts / sales.ts / khata.ts / master.ts are confirmed effective.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/frontend/app/inventory/tyre-form.tsx:92 — `perms.canEditStock` is derived from an async Firestore fetch. Redirecting on the first render causes false-negatives; gate on a `perms.loading` flag.

/app/frontend/app/sales/new.tsx:161-186 — post-save side-effects (KhataBook write + PDF share) are chained inside the same try block. A throw from `addKhataEntry` or `generateAndShareInvoice` (the latter is wrapped in .catch but the former is NOT) will prevent router.replace and leave the user on /sales/new with no feedback.

/app/frontend/src/firebase/util.ts stripUndefined() — implementation looks correct, handles serverTimestamp sentinel via `_methodName` check, recurses into nested plain objects, and preserves arrays. All Firestore writers use it — the 'Unexpected token' crash is confirmed FIXED (empty GSTIN/address/state code sale saved cleanly).

/app/frontend/src/firebase/auth.ts:64-103 — upsertUserDoc correctly merges into users/{uid} with role/name/email/timestamps. Verified in Admin → Users (3 owner accounts listed, including both fresh signup emails). GOOD.
/app/frontend/src/firebase/inventory.ts:53-64 — composite `where + orderBy` combination fully removed; sorting is now client-side via localeCompare. GOOD.
/app/frontend/src/firebase/master.ts:187-194 — getShopSettings now uses direct getDoc(settings/shop) instead of scanning the collection. Persistence across reload confirmed.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration-14 blockers are RESOLVED: users/{uid} is now written on signup (Admin → Users lists it), the 'Unexpected token' Save-Sale bug is gone when leaving GSTIN/address/state empty, and no composite-index errors appear anywhere in the app. Two follow-ups remain: (1) tyre-form direct-URL redirect race (real users clicking Add Tyre from the Inventory screen may work; deep-link/refresh does NOT) — fix by adding a `perms.loading` gate; (2) Credit-payment sale does not redirect + does not create a khata entry — Cash payment works, so the divergence is in the Credit branch of app/sales/new.tsx (addKhataEntry or PDF share throwing without catch). Once fixed, re-verify: (a) click Add Tyre from /(tabs)/inventory after full app boot → tyre-form should load, save MRF ZLX & JK Tyre OLD-1; (b) create Credit sale → verify KhataBook entry appears at /khata for mobile 9990001111.
rca_of_issue: REPRODUCTION 1 (perms race): 1. Signup as new owner → /dashboard loads with Owner banner ✓ (perms have hydrated). 2. `page.goto('/inventory/tyre-form')` → immediately redirects to /(tabs)/inventory because on first render `perms.canEditStock` is false (Firestore users/{uid} fetch is still in flight). Fix: expose `loading` from usePermissions and skip the redirect while loading. REPRODUCTION 2 (credit sale): 1. Save Cash sale → redirects to /(tabs)/billing, TB-0004 appears ✓. 2. Save Credit sale with same fields (payment mode = Credit) → URL stays /sales/new, no bill row added, no ledger entry at /khata. No error text on screen, no error in console. Most-likely cause: addKhataEntry(...) throws (permissions or a shape issue) and the outer catch shows the message but our screenshot may have missed it. Recommend adding a redbox/toast surface + console.error in the catch block.
